name: Recovered historical baseline
description: The 26-sample sequence of the 2013/2014 study, recovered by Hermitian inversion of its published coefficients. Physical identity, units and sampling rate unknown.

name: Bin-centered sinusoid
description: Sinusoid whose frequency coincides exactly with DFT bin 3; energy confined to one conjugate pair.

name: Non-bin-centered sinusoid
description: Sinusoid at a non-integer bin position (3.5); worst-case leakage at the half-bin offset.

name: Multi-component sinusoid with offset
description: Three sinusoidal components plus a constant offset chosen so that mean/std = 4.0.

name: Broadband zero-mean sequence
description: White Gaussian sequence, mean removed. Spectrally flat in expectation; a lower bound on achievable compaction.

name: Damped transient
description: Exponentially damped oscillation; energy localised in time and therefore spread in frequency.
